hero.subtitle: DevOpsAkademy was born from a simple observation: accessible DevOps training too often lacks hands-on depth. We set out to change that.

mission.title: Making DevOps skills accessible, in Africa and worldwide
mission.p1: Too often, the best DevOps resources are limited to a few markets, locked behind unaffordable paywalls, or disconnected from the reality of African tech teams. DevOpsAkademy bridges that gap.
mission.p2: We offer courses built by practitioners, with hands-on labs and an engaged community, at prices adapted to local markets.
points: Courses in French, using the industry's international terminology

expertise.title: Field expertise
expertise.desc: Our instructors are active practitioners. Every course reflects real challenges met in production.

fast.title: Learning by doing
fast.desc: A learn-by-doing method: interactive labs, running projects and quizzes at every step to lock in what you learn.

cert.title: Verifiable certification
cert.desc: Every learning path ends with a digital certificate that recruiters can verify online.

community.title: Active community
community.desc: Forum, peer support and live sessions. You never learn alone at DevOpsAkademy.

tech.title: The technologies you will master
tech.subtitle: The stack used in production by tech teams

founder.name: Vicky De Picard
founder.bio: 10 years of experience in cloud infrastructure. Former SRE at African scale-ups.

teachers.name: Teaching team
teachers.bio: AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, CI/CD: our instructors bring years of production experience.

support.name: Community support
